caption: The drawing depicts a bird, likely an eagle, perched on a green, rounded base. The bird is shown with its wings outstretched symmetrically on either side of its body. The feathers on the wings and body are rendered in shades of dark gray and black, with individual feathers detailed using white highlights. The bird’s head is angled slightly to the left and features a pale yellow beak and light gray feathers on top. The claws are large and colored in shades of tan and orange, gripping the green base below. The background of the drawing is a plain beige color, and there are faint pencil lines forming a rectangular border around the image.
title: Eagle
